summary: The registrant's subsidiary TGE completed acquisition of 50% interests in The Ritz-Carlton, Perth for US$72M (A$100M), valuing the property at A$280M. The deal was already consummated as of May 29, 2026, with no stated premium, board recommendation, or advisors. No other structural details or regulatory timelines are disclosed. This Form 6-K reports a closed transaction, so the risk-arb angle is moot; watch for integration updates on TGE's hospitality portfolio expansion toward nearly 1,000 rooms.
